**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, § 7.7).**

- **Investigation:** Searched the whole document for liquidated damages, penalties, minimum/early-termination charges and late-payment interest. The only Customer-payable liquidated amount is § 7.7 (p0032). § 10 (effect of termination) imposes only payment for delivered work and requires Vendor refunds; § 27 lets us terminate without penalty; § 3 and § 21 contain no damages payable by us. Nothing flagged that benefits us.
- **Why it fails fallback:** § 7.7 is not an early-termination fee, is uncapped and accrues weekly at 15% of annual Fees, and is triggered by a minor breach (late invoice) — squarely in walk-away territory.
- **Cure (preferred, single surgical replace, minimality gate ok):** § 7.7 now reads "Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement." No dangling cross-references result (§ 7.3's interest provision is unaffected), and the comment offers the capped early-termination-fee fallback.
